description: This is a PHPUnit test class named AbstractEndpointTest that tests the functionality of API endpoint classes within the OrangeHRM project, particularly focusing on sorting, pagination, and request parameter handling in the Core API v2.

classes.name: AbstractEndpointTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that extends TestCase and tests various aspects of the API endpoint behavior, including request handling, parameter rules, and sorting/pagination functionalities.

methods.name: testEndpoint
methods.description: Verifies that getRequest, getRequestParams, and getValidationDecorator methods return instances of Request, RequestParams, and ValidationDecorator respectively.

methods.name: testGetSortingAndPaginationParamsRules
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of sorting and pagination parameter rules, including default and overridden scenarios.

methods.name: getSortingAndPaginationParamsRules
methods.description: Helper method to invoke the protected getSortingAndPaginationParamsRules method of Endpoint.

methods.name: testSortOrderParamsRules
methods.description: Validates the acceptable values for the sortOrder parameter and checks that invalid values throw exceptions.

methods.name: testLimitParamsRules
methods.description: Validates permissible values for limit parameter; accepts null, numeric, and boundary values.

methods.name: testLimitParamsRulesExceptions
methods.description: Ensures invalid limit values, such as strings or negatives, trigger InvalidParamException.

methods.name: limitParamsRulesExceptionDataProvider
methods.description: Provides test cases with invalid limit values for exception testing.

methods.name: testOffsetParamsRules
methods.description: Validates valid and boundary values for offset parameter.

methods.name: testOffsetParamsRulesExceptions
methods.description: Ensures invalid offset values cause InvalidParamException.

methods.name: offsetParamsRulesExceptionDataProvider
methods.description: Provides invalid offset values for exception testing.

methods.name: testSortFieldParamsRules
methods.description: Validates accepted sortField values, including null, empty, and valid strings.

methods.name: testSortFieldParamsRulesExceptions
methods.description: Checks that invalid sortField values throw InvalidParamException.

methods.name: sortFieldParamsRulesExceptionDataProvider
methods.description: Provides invalid sortField values for testing exceptions.

methods.name: testSetRequestParams
methods.description: Tests that setting request parameters via setRequestParams correctly updates the internal state.

methods.name: testSetSortingAndPaginationParams
methods.description: Verifies that setting sorting and pagination parameters from query inputs correctly populates the FilterParams object.

methods.name: setSortingAndPaginationParamsDataProvider
methods.description: Provides various sets of query parameters and expected results for pagination and sorting parameter setting tests.

methods.name: getMockEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a mocked instance of Endpoint with a given query for testing.
